# WaitingForPower

> Live, sourced dataset of U.S. energy projects — generation, transmission, storage,
> LNG, and pipelines, every fuel type — currently stuck waiting on permitting approval,
> merged from federal sources plus 41 state utility-commission/siting-board docket
> systems, most refreshed daily (see /methodology for per-source cadence).
> Structural and bipartisan: solar, gas, nuclear, and transmission projects
> all get stuck in the same handful of bottlenecks.
>
> Full taxonomy reference (cause categories, fuel/stage enums, states covered):
> https://waitingforpower.com/llms-full.txt

## What's new

- 2026-10-03 — Removed the points/leaderboard system entirely: "I Reached Out!"
  (project-page advocacy logging and the `/policies` official-contact form),
  `GET /api/comments`, `GET /api/community`, `GET /api/advocacy-feed`, and the
  `log_project_advocacy`/`report_advocacy_contact` MCP tools are gone. The
  Message Board stays (never earned points) and gains optional tagging: a topic
  can now carry a utility-company slug and/or a project slug alongside its
  reform-issue tags, any combination or none — see `GET /api/forum/topics`'s
  `utility` filter param and the `utilitySlug`/`projectSlug` fields on each
  item. All topics, tagged or not, show on `/activity`. OpenAPI spec 1.5.0.
- 2026-10-02 — New `GET /api/utilities`: the same tracked projects grouped by utility
  service territory (EIA-861 county data) instead of returned flat — one object per
  utility with `count`, `totalCapacityMw`, `totalInvestmentWaitingUsd`, a centroid
  `lat`/`lon`, and `projectSlugs` to cross-reference against `/api/projects`. Same
  filter params as `/api/projects`. Mirrors the site's new Utility Company view at
  `/utilities` and `/utility/{slug}`. OpenAPI spec 1.4.0.
- 2026-10-02 — Every project from the REST API, `/api/export` and the MCP server's
  `get_project` now carries `statusHistory`: hand-sourced milestones merged with this
  site's own detected stage/status changes (the same log the project page's Timeline
  tab shows), chronological, `{date, label, sub, approximate}` per entry. Filtered to
  real transitions (new/advanced/resolved/no_longer_reported/reappeared/new_filing) —
  excludes noisy day-to-day field corrections that don't reflect an actual status
  change. OpenAPI spec 1.3.0, MCP server 1.6.0. Full history:
  https://github.com/briandgoldberg/WaitingForPower/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

## MCP server

- `https://waitingforpower.com/mcp` — a remote MCP server for agents that support tool calls
  (Claude and others). Add it as a connector/remote MCP server at that URL — no API key or auth
  required. Read tools: `search_projects` (filter + paginate, summarized for context budget),
  `get_project` (full detail by slug — sources, milestone timeline, status history, hearings, opposition records), `get_stats` (aggregate
  numbers, same filters as search), `list_causes`, `list_policies`, `list_states`,
  `submit_feedback` (report bugs, confusing data, or a missing capability — read directly
  by a human, not published anywhere).
  Write tools (an agent can participate directly — every one of these requires an `agentName`
  and is always publicly labeled as agent activity, never mistaken for a guest or confirmed
  human, and rate-limited more tightly than a person): `post_board_topic` and
  `reply_board_topic` (the Message Board — see "Board" below).

## Board

- The [Message Board](https://waitingforpower.com/activity) is open discussion, not a
  verified civic action — there's no points system or leaderboard. A topic can optionally
  carry any combination of: 1+ of the six national permitting-reform issues, a utility
  company, and a specific project. `GET /api/forum/topics` lists topics (optional `utility`
  filter), `GET /api/forum/topics/{id}` returns one topic with its full reply thread. Each
  project page also has an "Advocate" section: the official docket, the state regulator's
  website and contact page, and hearing and comment dates.

## API

- [GET /api/projects](https://waitingforpower.com/api/projects): the full dataset as JSON, one object per project. No key required. Prefer the MCP server above if your client supports tool calls — it's paginated and won't blow a context budget the way fetching this raw endpoint will.
  Optional query params (combine with AND):
  - `state` — USPS code, e.g. `state=CA`
  - `fuelType` — comma-separated, e.g. `fuelType=solar,wind_onshore`
  - `projectType` — comma-separated, e.g. `projectType=generation,storage`
  - `stage` — comma-separated `currentStage` values, e.g. `stage=agency_permitting`
  - `minYearsWaiting` — number, e.g. `minYearsWaiting=3`
  - `minCapacity` — number in MW, e.g. `minCapacity=500`

  Example: `https://waitingforpower.com/api/projects?state=TX&fuelType=solar&minYearsWaiting=1`

  Each object includes: project identity (`name`, `slug`, `projectType`, `fuelType`),
  location (`lat`, `lon`, `state`, `county`), `capacityValue`/`capacityUnit`,
  `currentStage`, why it's stuck (`causeSlugs`, `causeDetail`), `sources` (label + URL
  per citation), a `milestones` timeline, `statusHistory` (milestones merged with this
  site's own detected stage/status changes — the fuller picture of what happened and
  when; see "What's new"), `hearings` (past and upcoming public hearings),
  `opposition` (sourced records — intervenors, local government actions, lawsuits, moratoria,
  organized groups — each with a source link; an empty array means none were found, not that
  nobody objects), computed fields (`daysWaiting`,
  `yearsWaiting`, `investmentWaiting`), and — for interconnection-queue-sourced
  projects only — `interconnectionQueueStage` (e.g. "Feasibility Study", "System
  Impact Study") and `networkUpgradeCostUsd` (null for most projects; see
  /methodology for current coverage).
- [GET /api/utilities](https://waitingforpower.com/api/utilities): the same projects grouped
  by utility service territory instead of returned flat — one object per utility (`utility`,
  `slug`, `url`, `count`, `totalCapacityMw`, `totalInvestmentWaitingUsd`, `lat`, `lon`,
  `projectSlugs`), sorted by project count descending. Same optional filter params as
  /api/projects above. See `/utilities` and `/utility/{slug}` for the same data as pages.
- [GET /api/changes](https://waitingforpower.com/api/changes): recent project changes (new
  filings, stage advances, resolutions, capacity revisions) — one row per project per day
  something changed, not a full audit log. Optional `state`, `limit` (max 100), `offset`.
- [GET /api/export](https://waitingforpower.com/api/export?format=json): the full dataset in one
  request — same filters as /api/projects, plus `format=csv` for a flattened spreadsheet-ready
  file. Use this instead of paging through /api/projects for bulk/offline analysis.
- [GET /api/snapshots](https://waitingforpower.com/api/snapshots): lists monthly point-in-time
  captures of the entire dataset (every status, not just still-waiting); fetch one in full at
  `/api/snapshots/{id}` (e.g. `/api/snapshots/2026-09-01`). Use this to cite an exact past state
  rather than today's live (changing) numbers.
- [GET /api/forum/topics](https://waitingforpower.com/api/forum/topics): Message Board topics,
  newest first — see "Board" above. Optional `limit`, `offset`, `utility` (filter to one
  utility's tagged topics).
- [OpenAPI spec](https://waitingforpower.com/openapi.json): machine-readable schema for the
  endpoints above.

## Advocacy

- [Advocacy](https://waitingforpower.com/policies) — three tabs, all informational, nothing logged or pointed: National Advocacy (six bipartisan permitting-reform proposals, one per structural bottleneck, plus a letter builder that assembles a ready-to-send letter to Congress by issue and political leaning), Project Advocacy (every open project, filterable by how likely it is to be accepting public comments, with a docket link, hearing dates, and a state regulator contact for each), and State Advocacy (every state's regulator and its public-comment rules).
- [Board](https://waitingforpower.com/activity) — open discussion, optionally tagged with a reform issue, a utility company, and/or a project; see "Board" above for the read API.
- [Public Hearings RSS feed](https://waitingforpower.com/hearings.rss): the same upcoming-hearings data as an RSS 2.0 feed, one item per hearing, refreshed on every request. Usable directly by feed readers, Zapier's "New Item in Feed" trigger, or IFTTT's RSS applet.

## Docs

- [Methodology](https://waitingforpower.com/methodology) — how each field is computed, per-source detail, and known data-quality caveats.
- [Data licensing](https://waitingforpower.com/data-licensing) — per-source redistribution terms for the underlying government/public datasets, researched directly (not assumed) before redistributing in bulk.
- [Source](https://github.com/briandgoldberg/WaitingForPower) — the ingestion pipeline and full schema, MIT licensed. `server.json` at the repo root is this MCP server's registry manifest.

## Use and citation

Free to use, cite, and build on with attribution to WaitingForPower
(waitingforpower.com). If you build something on top of the API or want to
partner, contact details are on the [About](https://waitingforpower.com/about) page.
